'''Lyonie''' was an [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who served as a Representative and then the [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the successor to [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], who retired during the war.

==Biography==
===Early carrer===
[[File:Gungan_High_Council.png|thumb|left|250px|Rep Lyonie (far left) was one of five Reps sitting on the High Council in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].]]In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name=":2">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Lyonne was one of the Representatives<ref name=":3">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> of the Otoh Gunga High Council during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. He was present when the Council met the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name=":4">{{Film|I}}</ref>

By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref>[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 41|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 41]] {{C|20 BBY 19-22: The Battle of Mon Cala}} dates the events of "[[Gungan Attack]]" to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Lyonie replaced [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] as [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]],<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Valley">[[Rugor Nass/Legends|Gugor Nass]] was still Boss in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] in [[The Clone Wars: The Valley|''The Clone Wars: The Valley'']].</ref> becoming the leader of the High Council.<ref name="Gungan Attack" /> As leader of the Rep Council, Boss Lyonie held ultimate authority over the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].<ref name=":1">{{SWE|characters|bosslyonie|Boss Lyonie}}</ref>

===Dispatching the Gungan Army===
During the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|unrest]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] contacted [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] Lyonie to request the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] as reinforcements for the ongoing battle on Dac,<ref name="Gungan Attack" /> as his approval was required to order it into combat.<ref name=":1" /> Although Lyonie was initially hesitant, [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] convinced him that helping [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]&mdash;who had been trapped on Dac by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] alongside the beleaguered [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]]&mdash;was of the utmost importance and urgency. Lyonie agreed and dispatched Jar Jar Binks to lead the Gungan army to Dac.<ref name="Gungan Attack" />

===Rebelling Against the Naboo===
<!--This section is way too play-by-play. Please see what you can do to lessen the detail-->
[[File:RishLooManipulatingBossLyonie.png|thumb|250x250px|Boss Lyonie under the influence of [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]].]]
Late that year<ref>[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 75|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 75]] {{C|20 BBY 23-24: The Capture of Grievous}} dates the events of "[[Shadow Warrior]]" to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> one of Lyonie's assistants, [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]] gave him a necklace, promising him that it would make him a good leader. However, unknown to Lyonie, Loo was conspiring with Separatist leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Dooku wanted to create a rift between the Gungans and the Naboo.<ref name=":0" /> The necklace was actually a type of [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] known as an [[amulet of influence]],<ref name="Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> and as a result, Lyonie fell under its spell, and Loo's influence. He began berating the Naboo for their insolence and declared war on them, and making plans to march on the capital of Naboo, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name=":0" /> This caused many to fear that he would be siding with the Separatists.<ref name=":1" />

This act worried many including [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]] as well as the Naboo, forcing them to call on Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her Jedi bodyguard, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to investigate. They were present during Lyonie's briefing on the Naboo and surmised that Lyonie was under a spell by the way he was swaying around and speaking. Skywalker spotted the necklace around Lyonie and shattered it, breaking Loo's spell and knocking Lyonie out of the trance. Skywalker asked about the necklace and Lyonie confirmed that Loo gave it to him. The Gungan, along with the Jedi and Senator moved towards Loo's office. Lyonie decided to confront him alone, leaving Skywalker and Amidala outside. He stormed into Loo's office and accused the traitorous Gungan of controlling him like a puppet. At first, Loo tried to deny it but seeing Lyonie was onto to him, made a second attempt to hypnotize him using the necklace Loo had. Skywalker, sensing something was wrong ran up to the office accompanied by Amidala and confronted Loo. Loo called on [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid commandos]] given to him by Dooku suspended on the ceiling and ordered them to fire on the Jedi and Senator. During the scuffle, Loo attempted to run away but Lyonie grabbed him and they began to scuffle. However, Loo swung out a knife and stabbed Lyonie with it, wounding the Boss. Loo then escaped under the cover of his droids.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>
[[File:NeeyutneeLeaves-SW.png|thumb|250x250px|Lyonie after the departure of the Separatists.|left]]
Lyonie was then treated for his wounds but he was unconscious and seeing that he didn't have time to call off the attack, it seemed impossible to stop, since Rish Loo had taken control of the Gungans and tried to martyr the supposedly dead Lyonie. However, Amidala and Skywalker noticed a remarkable resemblance between Binks and Lyonie. They decided that Binks, posing as Lyonie could stop the attack. Although Binks was hesitant at first, he decided to go through with the duo's plan. Jar Jar was eventually able to call off the attack and turn the Gungans against Loo after exposing his treachory. Although the invasion was called off, it did it come at a heavy cost: Roos Tarpals was killed while defending Naboo from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Lyonie woke up in time to see Amidala arguing with Dooku for Skywalker's release who was captured while pursuing Loo. Dooku offered to release Skywalker in exchange for General Grievous who was captured by the Gungans. Lyonie knew this could turn the tide of the war but he, along with Jar Jar believed that Skywalker's life was of greater value so it was agreed upon that an exchange would be made. The same night, after the exchange, Lyonie expressed his gratitude towards Jar Jar for his role in solving the conflict.<ref name=":0" />

===Legacy===
Eventually Nass came out<ref name=":5">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref> of retirment<ref name=":6">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep404|text="Shadow Warrior" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> and took again the role of Boss<ref name=":5" /> by around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name=":2" /> repleacing Lyonie.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, Boss Lyonie was voiced by [[Ahmed Best]], who also voiced [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] for the series.<ref name="Gungan Attack" /><ref name=":0" /> The creation of the character was made as [[George Lucas]] wanted to make a story where [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] was easily mistaken for the leader of the Gungans.<ref name="SW-Questions Answered: Nass, Orphne and Willow">{{SW|url=video/questions-answered-nass-orphne-and-willow-the-clone-wars|text=Questions Answered: Nass, Orphne and Willow}}</ref> He was specifically created to resemble Jar Jar Binks, as they were built upon the same animation model. For the story to work Boss [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]] was written out of the series. His name was "Boss Nat", but that proven too confusingly similar to Nass' name.<ref name=":6" /> 

''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]'' retconned<ref name=":3" /> one of the Gungans of High Council in {{Film|I}}<ref name=":4" /> as Lyonie.<ref name=":3" /> In the [[Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace 1|manga adaptation]] of the film such character appears to be covered by [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]]' speech baloon.<ref name="Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace 1">[[Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace 1|''Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace'' 1]]</ref>
